seed: Objects of type `refuel` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x15, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 steps 5 cells per A1-A4; dest box with any colour-4/5 cell or off-board is blocked (still burns 2 bar cells).
Full 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge = conveyor: player slides away until blocked.
Every action turns the two leftmost bar 11s to 3; covering a refuel consumes it and refills the bar (the refuel A4 'gone' case = player box fully covers it, not click position); covering a collect rotates HUD glyph 90 CW.
Hidden state: underlay below player, used only when incoming frame equals last returned frame (else player box painted 3).
Unconfirmed (not observed): recolor token (glyph -> 9) and chamber lock (free reject while glyph != legend).
